W-gaps: the Expert view lifted out of the Workshop - the last request this page sent (or prepared) in words, the raw JSON under „Szczegóły techniczne”; opened as the shell panel `request` (chat menu „Pokaż zapytanie”, sentence „pokaż zapytanie” / „show the request”). W11a-1: a tree around any root of the graph (a unit, an import, a conversation ...): the children graph.navigate gives, grouped by what the structure templates (runtime/structure_templates.pack, examples) expect, the missing expectations as ghosts never stored; the look of each state is a mapping as data (shell/data/structure_mappings.json, preset me_inferred_opacity). Opened as the shell panel `structure` (switcher, sentence „pokaż strukturę projektu X”). Read only: filling a ghost is W11a-2.

state_keepers.params: the layout: the window's params travel with it (journal, last layout, named layouts)
state_keepers.scroll: the window host (WindowHost KeptScroll): scroll positions inside a framed window's body, kept at unmount, restored at mount
state_keepers.camera: the coupling values (W8, window_param_values in the last view): zoom and pan of the graph map
state_keepers.view_mode: the page store (keep.ts useKeptState): the preview/source switch of the artifact window
